The main takeaway from our work is that
the long term mechanical behaviour is strongly affected by filler type, and by filler content.

the mechanical properties of injection moulded TLCPs are highly dependent on the orientation of the material and the orientation of the filler particles, which is a function of the moulding conditions.

the mechanical properties of filled TLCP mouldings are not simply a superposition of the properties of the unfilled polymer and the filler; rather they are a function of the complex interaction between the polymer, filler, moulding geometry and processing conditions.
